title: Discover Victrix
description: Victrix is the IT partner of the largest companies in Canada, specializing in cybersecurity, managed services, AI, cloud and application services.

sections.title: Discover Victrix
sections.lead: Renowned for its high-quality services and distinctive customer experience, Victrix offers a proven approach that combines excellence, agility and proximity.

sections.title: Our Culture
paragraphs: At Victrix, we know that traditional ways of doing things are no longer sufficient to achieve the highest levels of performance and exceed the expectations of our customers, partners and employees.

sections.title: Victrix at a Glance
sections.intro: We are committed to being Canada's leading IT consulting firm by shaping a corporate culture where employees, partners and clients can achieve their ambitions.

featured.title: A Local IT Force with International Reach
featured.text: Founded in 2003, Victrix grew through successive acquisitions and joined the Alan Allman Associates international ecosystem in 2019.

aside.title: Happy At Work
aside.text: Victrix is HappyIndex® AtWork certified as a company "where people are happy to work".

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.lead: Victrix is committed to being Canada’s leading IT services company for business productivity by shaping a corporate culture where employees, partners and clients can achieve their ambitions.
sections.engagementText: By offering high quality technology solutions and a first-class customer experience, Victrix achieves its goals when we contribute significantly to the performance and competitiveness of our customers.

sections.title: Our Ecosystem
sections.lead: Alan Allman Associates is a dynamic ecosystem comprising a portfolio of 15 consulting firms, organized around four key areas of expertise: High-Tech, Industrial Transformation, Strategy and Management, and Digital Marketing.
sections.engagementText: With a community of over 3,300 experts by the end of 2024, our presence is expanding internationally, particularly in France, Benelux, the Iberian Peninsula, Asia and North America.
